Featured app

Alarm Clock Planner

Set an alarm for any date, not just this week.

Alarms weeks or months ahead, monthly and yearly repeats, alarm groups and custom sounds. It rings on Silent, and no account is needed.

Why I made itI noticed how many people look for a better alarm app, then built it around my own mess: my wake-ups, family events, my daughter's after-school activities, and a quick 15-minute nap.

SOON

Choru

A family chore chart where every chore comes back when it's due.

Daily dishes and the oven every three months share one list. A missed chore carries over as one row, and kids earn coins for rewards you pick.

Why I made itI wanted an easier way to run our family chores, and to motivate my daughter with rewards so she earns her screen time and toys.

NEW

CharacterSheet

Workouts, reading and meditation become XP. Level up in real life.

Six stats, each from level 1 to 60. Finish quests, some of them hidden, and stack buffs for sleep, water and streaks. Skip a stat and it loses XP.

Why I made itI wanted to work out more and turn life into an RPG. I'm a looooong way from level 60, and that's the point: level 60 runs marathons.

DownloadRead more

Scooch

Will it fit? Draw your rooms to scale and know before you carry anything.

Type a wall's length and it stays exact. 37 furniture pieces at real sizes turn red when they collide, and doors show the space they need to open.

Why I made itWe rearrange our apartment every so often or think about an upgrade, and I needed to know if that IKEA wardrobe would actually fit.

DownloadRead more

Rise

Stop the alarm and your morning starts with a focus timer.

The alarm rings even on Silent. Stopping it opens a short focus session on your Lock Screen, and every finished morning grows your streak.

Why I made itI wanted to get up early and build apps before work and family life start. Rise is the alarm that gets me out of bed to do it.

DownloadRead more

Remi

Reminders for an exact date, early March, or just someday.

Pick early March, or just someday, when that is all you know. See your whole year at a glance, with eight widgets and a one-time unlock.

Why I made itMy first app. I needed an easy way to track vaccines due years from now, and things like calling the dentist in two months.
